meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 它把设计对照 Dieter Rams 的十条「好设计」原则逐条打 0–3 分并附证据,给出 NEW、REFINE 或 REDESIGN 结论,再生成一份可直接运行的 /make-plan 交接提示词,产物写入 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你要求审计某个设计、做设计评审,或提到「design audit」等关键词时触发;若设计尚不存在,则直接跳到 NEW 结论。

say.text: 审计这个设计,对照 Rams 十条原则打分
say.note: 产出带证据的评分卡与结论

say.text: 这是我们的注册页,做一次设计审计
say.note: 先锁定审计范围再收集证据

say.text: 评审这个界面,并给我一份 /make-plan 交接提示词
say.note: 结论为 NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN 三选一

howto.what_en: It scores a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, 0–3 each with cited evidence, picks a verdict (NEW, REFINE, or REDESIGN), and emits a ready-to-run /make-plan handoff prompt into a DESIGN-IS-<date>/ folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit or critique a design, request a design review, or say "design audit" and want a plan next. If no design exists yet, it jumps to the NEW verdict.

say_en.text: Audit this design against the ten Rams principles.
say_en.note: Yields an evidence-cited scorecard and verdict

say_en.text: This is our signup page — run a design audit on it.
say_en.note: Locks scope first, then gathers evidence

say_en.text: Review this UI and hand off a /make-plan prompt.
